deadline.value: Applications are accepted all year round for most research groups, subject to specific funder or supervisor deadlines.
deadline.quote: We accept applications all year round for some groups but you may want to check specific deadlines with your supervisor or prospective funder.

entry_route.value: Standard doctoral entry requires a 2:1 honours degree in a relevant subject, or a 2:2 with a Merit at master's level.
entry_route.quote: 2:1 (or international equivalent) in a relevant subject or 2:2 (or international equivalent) in a relevant subject with a Merit at masters level; other qualifications may also be accepted.

supervisor.value: Postgraduate researchers work under the direction of an academic supervisor with regular supervisory meetings.
supervisor.quote: You will have at least 10 meetings per year with your supervisor.

funding.value: Postgraduate research funding is competitive through university studentships and research council awards.
funding.quote: Check our guide to find out more about funding your postgraduate degree.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

notes: Postgraduate research programme (Biosciences PhD) in the School of Biosciences at the University of Nottingham.
